caption: The drawing depicts a piece of lace fabric on a light beige or off-white background. The lace section is filled with intricate patterns consisting predominantly of dark brown or black floral motifs. Larger floral and leafy patterns cluster towards one side, and smaller, repeating flowers are distributed more sparsely across the fabric. The bottom and right edges of the lace design feature a scalloped border, with each scallop containing clustered, circular flower patterns and small decorative elements. The individual lace threads and meshwork structure are depicted in a fine, detailed manner, showing transparency in the material. The overall composition is rectangular, with the lace taking up most of the area, except for the plain border around it.
title: Black Lace Shawl
